# Bhava: by The Spiritual Company

> Bhava: is an Indian ritual brand offering incense sticks, bamboo-less incense, incense cones, sambrani (guggal) offering cups, ritual camphor and sacred bead bracelets, along with curated ritual collections. Prices are in INR; shipping is ₹50 below ₹501 and free at ₹501 and above.

## Shop

- [Shop all products](https://www.bhavaglobal.com/products): Full catalogue with filters by format
- [Curated collections](https://www.bhavaglobal.com/products?category=curated-collections): Thoughtfully paired ritual sets priced at the sum of their contents
- [Incense sticks](https://www.bhavaglobal.com/products?category=incense-sticks): Sacred Notes incense in Guggal, Oud and Sandalwood
- [Bamboo-less incense](https://www.bhavaglobal.com/products?category=bamboo-less-incense): Pure Ritual incense
- [Incense cones](https://www.bhavaglobal.com/products?category=incense-cones): Sacred Ember cones
- [Sambrani](https://www.bhavaglobal.com/products?category=sambrani): Sambrani (Guggal) offering cups
- [Camphor](https://www.bhavaglobal.com/products?category=camphor): Ritual camphor
- [Sacred beads](https://www.bhavaglobal.com/products?category=sacred-beads): Sacred bead bracelets
